title: Siegebreaker Warmace
html:
Source not yet observed

Skill needed

Wielding it takes the Mace weapon skill. No class starts with it. To learn it, finish the quest The Broken Hammers (Hester Bell near Rustpick Mine, warriors, level 11): free, and you keep the skill for good.

See Weapon skills & specials for how the skill levels and what it unlocks.

How to get it

Unique. Dropped by Siegemaster Grukh on 1% of kills (5% from an elite). Built on Titanium Warmace. A unique can’t be enchanted.

  • Up to 20% of hits sunder the target's armor, fewer against stronger foes.

See Unique items for all of them.

No monster drops recorded for this item.
